name: Claude Code
summary: Connect Claude Code to your databases through the MCP server built into TablePro.
description: On a Mac, Claude Code runs the bundled tablepro-mcp bridge as a local MCP server. On Linux, it connects to TablePro's MCP server over HTTP on 127.0.0.1 with an access token. Setup is one claude mcp add command.

disclosures.accessNote: On a Mac it uses the Read & Write token of the bundled bridge, on Linux the access token from the MCP page of Preferences. Each connection's External Clients level and Safe Mode still apply.
disclosures.networkNote: Claude Code sends tool results, such as connection names, schemas and rows, to its model provider.
